text:
The iron cylinder of an engine is to be fitted into a piece of aluminium.
The outside diameter M of the iron cylinder is slightly larger than the diameter N of the hole in the
aluminium.
iron cylinder
M
aluminium
N
What is the best action to fit the cylinder into the aluminium?
A
Cool the aluminium and cool the iron.
B
Cool the aluminium and heat the iron.
C
Heat the aluminium and cool the iron.
D
Heat the aluminium and heat the iron.

options.label: A
options.text: Cool the aluminium and cool the iron.

options.label: B
options.text: Cool the aluminium and heat the iron.

options.label: C
options.text: Heat the aluminium and cool the iron.

options.label: D
options.text: Heat the aluminium and heat the iron.
